about.title: About M. Mohan Rao
about.subtitle: Insurance Advisor in Hosur • Life, Health & General Insurance
about.introSubtitle: Helping individuals, families, and business owners make informed insurance decisions with complete transparency.
about.bioP1: M. Mohan Rao is a professional Insurance Advisor based in Hosur, Tamil Nadu. He provides dedicated insurance consultation and policyholder servicing across Life Insurance (Life Insurance Corporation of India - LIC), Health Insurance (Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited), and General Insurance (United India Insurance Company Limited).
about.bioP2: In his life insurance advisory with LIC, he holds the prestigious distinctions of being an LIC Chairman's Club Member for Agents—LIC's highest recognition tier for exceptional performance—as well as an MDRT (Million Dollar Round Table) Member, representing the premier standard of financial professionals globally (LIC Agency Code: 0195676N).
about.bioP3: M. Mohan Rao's philosophy centers on transparent, client-first advisory. Rather than pushing generic policies, he carefully analyzes family medical requirements, income protection needs, liabilities, vehicle assets, and future financial milestones to recommend verified insurance solutions from appropriate companies.
about.bioP4: Beyond initial policy consultation, clients receive lifelong policy servicing including official online premium payment support, policy revival assistance, cashless hospitalisation guidance for Star Health, motor claim coordination for United India, and thorough claims documentation support for life and maturity claims.

items.q: Which insurance companies does M. Mohan Rao represent?
items.a: M. Mohan Rao provides advisory services for Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC - Life Insurance), Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited (Health Insurance), and United India Insurance Company Limited (General Insurance).
The advisory office is located on Bye-Pass Road, Hosur - 635109, Tamil Nadu, India. In-person consultations are available by appointment, alongside phone and WhatsApp support.

items.q: Can I enquire about health insurance for my family?
items.a: Yes. We provide complete guidance on Star Health family floater policies, individual health plans, senior citizen covers, critical illness protection, and cashless hospitalisation networks in Hosur.

items.q: Can I get vehicle and general insurance assistance?
items.a: Yes. We assist with United India Insurance policies covering two-wheelers, private cars, commercial transport, shops, and personal property, including timely renewals.

All premium payments are made directly to the respective insurance companies through their official online portals, authorized digital channels, or branch cash counters. The advisor does not accept personal payments.

items.q: How does the advisor assist during an insurance claim?
items.a: We assist policyholders and families with compiling required claim documentation, understanding policy coverage terms, and liaising with the respective insurer for smooth claim processing.
